2609.37916.title: RLX: A Unified Multi-Backend Tensor Compiler and Distributed Runtime in Rust
2609.37916.paper_summary: Production machine learning (ML) stacks often split graph compilation and kernel execution across different layers and languages, making backend behavior, deployment guarantees, and performance fallbacks hard to reason about end-to-end. RLX addresses this gap with a single Rust codebase that combines compiler and runtime roles around one primitive-level, three-level intermediate representation (IR), plus a transparent dispatch contract that resolves each operator to native, common-IR, or rewritten lowering and fails compilation when legalization is not possible. The same IR targets fourteen runtime devices (cpu, metal, mlx, ane, cuda, rocm, oneapi, tpu, hexagon, gpu, vulkan, opengl, directx, webgpu) and two specialty codegen paths (Cortex-M INT8 and FPGA), ingests safetensors, GGUF, ONNX, and rten formats, supports F16/BF16/F64/C64 and quantized INT4/INT8 flows with AMP/PTQ/QAT, and scales via tensor-/pipeline-parallel collectives over TCP and RDMA transports. Beyond neural workloads, RLX also extends to scientific/physics-style domains through sparse and dense linear algebra extensions (e.g., CSR LU/CG/matvec and LAPACK- backed factorizations) and 3D Gaussian splatting operators. We evaluate RLX against PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, candle, burn, tch, rten, MLX, CoreML, IREE, Glow, TensorRT, and tinygrad under identical input generation and p50 measurement methodology on one host. On all-MiniLM-L6-v2, RLX-Metal is fastest at every batch (e.g., 16.6 ms at batch 32 vs. PyTorch-MPS 26.7 ms). In the MNIST training table, RLX also has the top-throughput entry (graph-fused MLP: 946,487 img/s), above NumPy+BLAS (787,349 img/s), while retaining 100% top-1 parity on reference checks (e.g., Qwen3).
2609.37916.paper_summary_zh: 生產機器學習 (ML) 堆疊通常在不同的層級和語言之間拆分圖形編譯和內核執行，這使得端到端的後端行為、部署保證和性能回退難以推理。RLX 通過一個單一的 Rust 代碼庫來解決這一問題，該代碼庫將編譯器和運行時角色結合在一個原始級別、三級中間表示 (IR) 周圍，並加上一個透明的調度合約，該合約將每個運算符解析為原生、通用 IR 或重寫降級，並在合法化不可能時失敗編譯。相同的 IR 針對十四個運行時設備 (cpu、metal、mlx、ane、cuda、rocm、oneapi、tpu、hexagon、gpu、vulkan、opengl、directx、webgpu) 和兩條特殊的代碼生成路徑 (Cortex-M INT8 和 FPGA)，可以處理 safetensors、GGUF、ONNX 和 rten 格式，支持 F16/BF16/F64/C64 和量化的 INT4/INT8 流，並通過 TCP 和 RDMA 傳輸進行張量/管道並行集合擴展。除了神經工作負載，RLX 還通過稀疏和密集線性代數擴展（例如 CSR LU/CG/matvec 和基於 LAPACK 的分解）以及 3D 高斯點雲運算符擴展到科學/物理風格的領域。我們在同一主機上，根據相同的輸入生成和 p50 測量方法，將 RLX 與 PyTorch、TensorFlow、JAX、candle、burn、tch、rten、MLX、CoreML、IREE、Glow、TensorRT 和 tinygrad 進行評估。在 all-MiniLM-L6-v2 上，RLX-Metal 在每個批次中都是最快的（例如，在批次 32 時為 16.6 毫秒，而 PyTorch-MPS 為 26.7 毫秒）。在 MNIST 訓練表中，RLX 也擁有最高的吞吐量條目（圖形融合 MLP：946,487 img/s），高於 NumPy+BLAS（787,349 img/s），同時在參考檢查中保持 100% 的 top-1 一致性（例如，Qwen3）。
